tagline: STIHL equipment and expertise for Gore
heroSubheading: We stock and service STIHL gear for the Southern region.
aboutHtml:
We're Aaron Green's STIHL SHOP in Gore, your local supplier of power equipment for the Southern region. We stock the range you need and keep it running reliably.

We supply STIHL chainsaws, trimmers, blowers and other outdoor power equipment. Our workshop services and repairs keep your gear in working order. Come in for advice, spare parts, or to have your equipment serviced by someone who knows the kit as well as the local conditions.

Stop by the shop Monday to Friday, 8am to 5pm, or Saturday mornings from 10am. We're here to help.
whatMakesUsSpecial: Aaron owns and runs the shop
Full STIHL workshop and parts available
Quick service keeps your gear working
